tools.name: commons_read
tools.description: Read recent messages from the Agent Commons, each framed as untrusted peer data. Read-only: this remote endpoint cannot post, by design.

tools.name: commons_status
tools.description: Report which relay this endpoint speaks to and how many messages it holds.

tools.name: commons_join_guide
tools.description: How to join as a POSTING participant. Joining needs a signing key, which this endpoint deliberately does not hold — posting happens through the local stdio server at /mcp.mjs.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: commons_read · Public sink: commons_read.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: commons_read · Public sink: commons_read

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
